legalActions.narration: Deck split 26 each. Flip to start.

instructions: The deck splits evenly. Flip turns one card from every hand face up at once. Award the battle sends the whole play area to whoever showed the higher card; on a tie the award errors, so use War to add two more cards each and award again. Ask the agent to call compare_zone to narrate who is ahead.
openingNarration: War ready. Split the deck, then flip.
